method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Slides Fourth Straight Day as Oil Prices, Yields Surge
Equities.reason: Broad market risk-off: simultaneous oil spike and rising yields are pressuring equities across the board. This is a dominant macro narrative (higher inflation/real rates weighing on multiples), so high relevance and negative direction.

Equities.title: Indian shares slide to three-month low in broad-based sell-off on Mideast worries
Equities.reason: Emerging-markets selling tied to geopolitical risk and higher oil — reinforces global risk-off flow and contagion to equities outside the US; moderate-high relevance for market sentiment.

Equities.title: Stocks extend losses on rate hike fears
Equities.reason: Rate-hike/higher-for-longer narrative directly undermines equities (multiple compression and rotation out of growth) — material negative for market risk appetite.

Equities.title: Investors seek hedges as midterms and geopolitical risks threaten market calm
Equities.summary: Investors are starting to seek more protection against stock market swings as a historically volatile period for markets approaches.
Equities.reason: Growing demand for hedges and rising VIX signals worsening risk sentiment into the midterms and geopolitical uncertainty — a market-wide negative for equities.

Equities.title: Oracle's stock edges up on earnings beat as cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubles
Equities.summary: Oracle's results for the quarter came in stronger than expected, as did its revenue backlog.
Equities.reason: Company-level positive tied to AI/cloud leadership — reinforces the ongoing tech/AI leadership narrative that supports parts of the equity market, though single-stock signal is moderate.

Equities.title: Chinese Nvidia rival Enflame soars 206% on stock market debut as AI demand stays hot
Equities.summary: Chinese AI chipmaker Enflame, an Nvidia rival and one of China's "four little dragons," made its Shanghai market debut.
Equities.reason: Strong IPO/sectoral demand for AI-related chipmakers underscores the persistent AI leadership trade and risk-on flows into tech names — positive for tech equities and sector leadership narrative.

Equities.title: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says
Equities.summary: Anthropic said it detected unauthorized efforts by China-based AI labs including Alibaba and Moonshot AI to use its Claude models to help improve their own AI systems.
Equities.reason: Security / IP risks in the AI ecosystem are a modest negative for investor appetite toward AI names; lower relevance than macro drivers but a meaningful sector-specific headwind.

Equities.title: 'Extinction' warnings ramp up as more OpenAI, Anthropic researchers join calls for an AI slowdown
Equities.summary: There is growing concern globally about the capability of AI, following numerous cyberattacks and security incidents in recent months by rogue models
Equities.reason: Escalating AI-safety debate injects political and regulatory risk into the AI leadership trade; this is a secondary negative signal versus the dominant macro (oil/yields) story.

Rates.title: Global bond selloff pushes 10-year US yield toward 5% on oil, rate-hike fears
Rates.reason: Headline describes a broad global bond selloff pushing the 10-year UST toward 5% driven by oil and rate-hike fears — a clear negative for bond prices and signals higher-for-longer policy pricing.

Rates.title: Treasury Yields Surge as Oil, Buyback Results Fuel Selloff
Rates.reason: Bloomberg frames the UST move as linked to oil and a buyback that failed to calm markets — reinforces the selloff narrative and upward pressure on yields (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Scott Bessent fails to break ‘fever’ in US bond market
Rates.summary: Treasury secretary’s $6bn bond operation is insufficient to stem the recent surge in borrowing costs, investors warn
Rates.reason: Coverage that the Treasury's buyback operation did not stop rising borrowing costs — supports the dominant narrative of persistent selling pressure and higher yields.

Rates.title: Bond yields hit multi-year highs as traders brace for new ECB rate-hike cycle
Rates.reason: Reports multi-year highs in bond yields tied to a new ECB hiking cycle — broadens the higher-yield theme beyond USTs and reinforces tighter global policy expectations.

Rates.title: BoJ set to raise interest rates by 25 bps next week - Reuters
Rates.summary: According to a Reuters report, sources say that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) is set to raise interest rates, most likely by 25 basis points, at the policy meeting on September 18. This move will push interest rates higher to 1.25%, a level not seen in the last 31 y
Rates.reason: An imminent BoJ rate hike implies higher JGB yields and contributes to global rate tightening — negative for bond prices and relevant to global rates positioning.

Rates.title: Japan’s Producer Price Gains Stay Elevated, Backing BOJ Hikes
Rates.reason: Data showing elevated PPI that supports BOJ tightening — a macro signal for higher yields in Japan and adds to global inflation/hike pressures (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Australia Bond Yields Jump to Highest Since 2011 on Oil Concerns
Rates.reason: Regional example of bond yields rising sharply (Australia) linked to oil — reinforces the global nature of the selloff and inflation-driven rate repricing.

Rates.title: Bessent’s intervention risks damaging BoJ’s credibility, bankers warn
Rates.summary: US Treasury secretary’s claims of insider knowledge could erode market perceptions of Japanese central bank’s independence
Rates.reason: Political/intervention concerns around a Treasury official potentially affecting central-bank credibility — raises risk of volatility in sovereign debt markets (negative but more idiosyncratic).

FX.title: Swiss Franc declines as US Dollar strengthens on rising Fed hike bets
FX.summary: USD/CHF gains ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.8140 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground as expectations grow for a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike in September.
FX.reason: Clear USD-strength narrative driven by rising Fed hike expectations. Direct FX transmission to CHF and part of a broader dollar-hawkish theme; moderate-high relevance for USD-centric FX flows.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah weakens against US Dollar amid budget pressures
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 17,660 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (ID) struggles with persistent fiscal concerns. As a net oil importer, Indonesia faces mounting budget pre
FX.reason: IDR-specific fiscal/budget pressure driving USD/IDR higher. Relevant to EMFX flows and the broader USD-safe-haven / Fed-hike backdrop, but more idiosyncratic than G10 moves.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar struggles as oil prices decline
FX.summary: USD/CAD extended its gains for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.3840 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) struggles due to lower oil prices.
FX.reason: CAD underperformance tied to falling oil—a clear CAD-specific FX transmission into USD/CAD. Fits USD-strength / commodity-hit CAD narrative; relevant for G10 cross moves.

FX.title: Euro: Downside risks while 1.1585 holds against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight growing downside momentum in EUR/USD after a sharp drop to 1.1591, though they see limited scope for a sustained break below 1.1585 in the very near term.
FX.reason: Analyst note pointing to EUR weakness vs USD, reinforcing the dominant dollar-strength narrative. Macro/EURUSD-focused piece with clear implications for USD flows; higher relevance.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Trades near 1.3850 after breaking above nine-day EMA
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its gains for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.3840 during the Asian hours on Friday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is remaining within the descending channel pattern, signalling a persistent bearish bi
FX.reason: Technical piece on USD/CAD confirming ongoing USD strength vs CAD. Technical analysis has lower relevance under the scoring rules but reinforces the CAD/commodity-driven FX move.

FX.title: Indian Rupee extends decline on fresh escalation in hawkish Fed bets
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its downward spiral against the US Dollar (USD) for the fourth trading day on Friday, with the USD/INR pair rising to near 95.80 in the opening session.
FX.reason: Fed-hawkishness pushing USD/INR higher — clear USD-strength transmission into a major EM currency. Relevant for EMFX flows and risk sentiment.

FX.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Softens to near 179.00, bearish bias remains intact below 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The EUR/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 179.10 during the early European session on Friday. The expectation of a Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate hike next week provides some support to the Japanese Yen (JPY) against the Euro (EUR).
FX.reason: BoJ rate-hike expectation is a potential central-bank shock supporting JPY strength. Although a non-USD cross, the BoJ move has broad FX implications (JPY appreciation), so it's included with above-average relevance.

FX.title: British Pound jumps after strong UK monthly GDP data
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) attracts significant bids against its peers, with the GBP/USD pair rising to near 1.3518, as the United Kingdom (UK) Office for National Statistics (ONS) has reported strong monthly Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data for July. Th
FX.reason: Stronger-than-expected UK GDP pushing GBP higher vs USD — clear USD-weakness transmission in GBP/USD. Macro data move with direct FX impact and elevated relevance for G10 currency dynamics.

FX.title: United Kingdom GDP grows by 0.4% MoM in July, vs. 0% expected
FX.summary: The UK Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 0.4% MoM in July, following a 0.3% growth reported in June, the latest data published by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Friday.
FX.reason: The underlying data that drove GBP strength in linked headlines. Included to reinforce the GBP-USD upside narrative; relevant macro datapoint but somewhat redundant with immediate FX reaction.

FX.title: Japan’s Katayama says to maintain close communication with US on currency markets
FX.summary: Japanese Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the government will ‌continue to closely communicate with the United States (US) to ensure orderly foreign exchange markets.
FX.reason: Official FX-market communication between Japan and the US signals policy coordination to ensure orderly FX conditions — a high-relevance FX-native news item that can underpin JPY support and limit disorderly USD moves.

FX.title: Edmond de Rothschild Says Buy Yen Dips as Carry Trade Unwinds
FX.reason: Market-strategy call that the carry unwind is supporting JPY — a clear FX flow narrative that reinforces JPY strength vs other currencies and contributes to USD weakness in JPY crosses.

Commodities.title: Gold falls below $4,350 as rising oil prices, US PPI reinforces Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) tumbles to near $4,320 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure after the US Producer Price Index (PPI) inflation data and rising oil prices increased bets for a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hi
Commodities.reason: US PPI and higher oil increased Fed rate-hike odds, a clear negative for gold (rate-sensitive metal).

Commodities.title: Gold bounces off one-week low as USD bulls await US CPI; Fed hike bets to cap gains
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers slightly from the $4,300 neighborhood, or a one-and-a-half-week low, touched during the Asian session on Friday, though the upside potential seems limited.
Commodities.reason: Small intraday rebound but upside capped by USD strength and Fed-hike expectations — modestly negative for metals.

Commodities.title: Gold Wavers as High Oil Prices, Inflation Bolster Rate-Hike Bets
Commodities.reason: Authoritative coverage linking rising oil/inflation to stronger Fed-hike pricing — a pronounced negative impulse for gold.

Commodities.title: ⁠Gold on track for third weekly loss as US inflation data looms​‌
Commodities.reason: Reuters notes a multi-week downtrend ahead of US inflation prints — reinforces the broader negative macro pressure on gold.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $63.50 amid rising Fed rate hike odds
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around $63.30 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Friday. Silver prices are declining as expectations grow for a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike in September.
Commodities.reason: Silver sliding on higher Fed-hike odds; follows precious-metal sensitivity to rates — meaningful but smaller market than gold.

Commodities.title: WTI trades near $99.00 after pulling back from nearly four-month highs
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) halts its four-day winning streak, trading around $99.00 per barrel during Asian hours on Friday. However, crude oil prices may rebound as the escalating conflict between the US and Iran has fueled concerns over prolonged disrupti
Commodities.reason: WTI remains elevated on US–Iran conflict risk; geopolitical premium supports oil prices despite short-term pullback.

Commodities.title: Oil Pushes Further Above $100 as Middle East Conflict Deepens
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg reports a meaningful geopolitical-driven oil rally above $100 — high-impact positive for crude markets and energy complex.

Commodities.title: Oil surges 6%, Brent and US crude both surpass $100 on more tanker attacks
Commodities.reason: Reuters highlights sharp crude gains after tanker attacks — a clear supply-risk driven bullish shock to oil prices.

Commodities.title: U.S. crude oil tops $100 again – last seen in May – as market braces for prolonged Iran war
Commodities.summary: Oil prices remain elevated amid worries that escalating tensions in the Middle East could further exacerbate supply disruptions
Commodities.reason: CNBC coverage of renewed $100+ prints underscores market concern about prolonged Middle East disruption — bullish for crude.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record crude oil production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. crude oil production will average 13.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 13.7 million b/d set in 2025, in our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: Higher U.S. production raises medium-term supply prospects, a structural headwind to oil prices amid the near-term geopolitical rally.

Commodities.title: Brent: Supply risks and Saudi cuts support prices – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Brent and WTI have rallied sharply as Middle East tensions escalate and Saudi Arabia reports a steep drop in output.
Commodities.reason: Analyst view that Saudi cuts plus Middle East risks underpin Brent — supportive for crude prices.

Commodities.title: Iran and Gulf states to meet in push for Hormuz deal
Commodities.summary: Regional states hope temporary shipping agreement between Iran and Oman can offer a pathway to ease hostilities and reopen the strait
Commodities.reason: Diplomatic efforts to secure shipping through Hormuz imply a potential reduction in the geopolitical premium — modestly negative for oil risk premium.

Commodities.title: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in the first half of 2026 because of higher capacity
Commodities.summary: U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to our Natural Gas Monthly. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we estimate U.S
Commodities.reason: Higher U.S. LNG exports reflect stronger international gas demand and support natural-gas price tone and global tightness.

Commodities.title: New England natural gas prices have been trading near record discounts to Henry Hub
Commodities.summary: Low-cost Appalachian and Canadian natural gas supplies coupled with lower-than-usual regional consumption have pushed down natural gas prices at a major New England pricing hub in recent months to trade at a discount to the widely cited U.S. benchmark, Henry H
Commodities.reason: Regional supply/demand balance and pipeline flows have driven New England hub discounts — bearish for regional gas prices.

Commodities.title: Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
Commodities.summary: What are crack spreads and why are they elevated? Crack spreads are indicators of the profitability of refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel. One common crack spread is calculated by subtracting the spot market price of a gallo
Commodities.reason: Elevated crack spreads indicate stronger refining margins and higher downstream fuel prices — supportive for RBOB/gasoline prices.

Commodities.title: Weekly average load in ERCOT continues near record high
Commodities.summary: Sustained high temperatures have contributed to persistently high electricity demand in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT), the regional transmission organization for most of the state.
Commodities.reason: Elevated power demand in ERCOT likely supports natural gas consumption for generation — modest positive for gas demand/prices.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin traders dial down bullish plays ahead of U.S. inflation data
Crypto.reason: Near-term risk-off positioning in BTC ahead of key CPI data reduces crypto leverage and directional flow; meaningful for short-term market sentiment and volatility.

Crypto.title: Why a new SEC plan could ease a legal headache for tokenized securities
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity from the SEC on tokenized securities would materially lower legal/frictional barriers for institutional adoption of tokenized assets — a meaningful positive structural development.

Crypto.title: New Clarity Act text tweaks DeFi, credit union provisions, but road ahead for bill remains murky
Crypto.reason: Legislative adjustments to DeFi rules signal incremental regulatory progress and potential easing of uncertainty, but bill prospects remain uncertain — modestly positive for DeFi adoption.

Crypto.title: Monument Bank delays retail tokenized deposits while onboarding custody partner
Crypto.reason: A delay to retail tokenized deposits is a tangible setback for tokenized deposit rollouts and signals regulatory/frictional headwinds for retail onchain banking products.

Crypto.title: SGX's bitcoin and ether perpetual futures are now open to U.S. institutions
Crypto.reason: Opening SGX perpetuals to U.S. institutions meaningfully expands institutional access and potential flow channels into BTC/ETH derivatives — a strong positive for liquidity and institutional adoption.

Crypto.title: MoneyGram unveils stablecoin-backed card as digital dollars move into everyday spending
Crypto.reason: A major payments player launching a stablecoin-backed card advances real-world stablecoin utility and consumer on‑ramp use cases — positive for stablecoin demand and payments adoption.

Crypto.title: Crypto researchers cut Bitcoin and Ethereum quantum attack estimate by 50%
Crypto.reason: Lowered probability/timeline for quantum-threat scenarios reduces a tail existential risk for BTC/ETH; constructive but more technical and longer-term in its market relevance.

Crypto.title: Indian agri warehouse giant is putting $2 billion in grain-backed loans onchain
Crypto.reason: Large-scale real-world-asset tokenization (USD2bn) represents substantive institutional/enterprise adoption of blockchain for lending and collateralized credit — a significant constructive signal.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin trades near $78,000 as memecoins, small caps lead a broad crypto retreat
Crypto.reason: Broad retreat led by memecoins and small caps indicates short-term risk-off and rotation away from highly speculative tokens, pressuring overall crypto market sentiment.

Crypto.title: Hunter Biden’s LAPTOP blames bots after 98% crash as traders rack up six-figure losses
Crypto.reason: A large memecoin/derivatives crash with heavy trader losses underscores retail risk, elevated volatility and potential deleveraging in the crypto ecosystem.
